I've saved this to project memory. Releases are now cut with `make release`, which creates the tag and publishes, so nobody should push release tags or publish by hand. The new note replaces the old one that said to push a `vYYYY.MM.N` tag and let CI publish.

This checkout doesn't have a `Makefile` with a `release` target yet. If that change hasn't landed here, `make release` will fail in this repo until it does.
